scope: Independently authored symbolic complete parent/member/closure states for the retained-stale-tuple candidate. Labels require actual original admitted artifacts; no wire encoding, native authority or runtime support follows. All dirty/reserved states refuse commit until complete finalization and independent required-effect proof.

cases.action: Register genuinely new original C under confirmed whole-operation containment
cases.oracle: Only member counter and membership generation advance once; original B clock/ordinal and finalized tuple remain unchanged.

cases.action: Register original catalog closure K required by the complete original producer union
cases.oracle: Only catalog counter and membership generation advance; member ordinals/clocks/address counter do not change.

cases.action: Register original configuration closure F required by the complete original producer union
cases.oracle: Only configuration counter and membership generation advance; complete original inventory bytes are retained.

cases.action: Repeat each complete identical original B/C/K/F registration
cases.oracle: No counter/generation/clock/address/ordinal/profile/manifest changes and no reservation/insertion statement invoked.

cases.action: Confirm C counter reservation then fail C insert; confirm rollback of the original registration savepoint
cases.oracle: The partial parent increment cannot survive containment; all preceding caller B originals remain exact.

cases.action: Create outer savepoint, perform RG01/RG02/RG03, then confirm rollback to that outer savepoint
cases.oracle: Rollback removes all three registration effects, restores all four counters/finalized originals, and invalidates retained C/K/F captures. Spent enclosing resource usage is not reset.

cases.action: Reserve C, submit insertion and lose original completion
cases.oracle: No known restored state, retry, successor registration or successful manifest is claimed before original reconciliation.

cases.action: Attempt same selected original C identity with different original payload/profile/owner/timing
cases.oracle: Complete duplicate scan detects conflict before any counter reservation; existing originals remain immutable.
